body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our cooperation and we understand the cost pressure on your side; we want an agreement that keeps our partnership healthy for both of us.
We have noted your offer and the rising labour and producer costs behind your calculation. We are open to finding value in the terms, and our proposal includes a binding volume confirmation and a faster-payment option.

We confirm a binding volume of 20000 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our demand forecast for this part is up 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose one of these packages; please choose the one that suits you best:
- Option A: EUR 4.77 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 20000 units a year over 36 months
- Option B: EUR 4.72 per unit, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 20000 units a year over 36 months

What would you need from us to move further on the price? We are open to discussing any term that helps you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal and the offer of a 36-month volume commitment. As to the delivery record and volume change data you cited, that does not change our position. While we have reviewed your delivery and volume data, our current business situation allows for only minimal price adjustments. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. We can therefore offer a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.
